title: Putting the Framework Together
subtitle: Choose a small, realistic plan for the week ahead
description: Recovery is rarely about one perfect technique. Use this check-in to connect what you have learned about symptoms, sleep, stress, movement, pacing, support, and meaningful activity. Your answers can help guide a conversation with your clinician; they are not a diagnosis or a substitute for medical advice.

fields.label: Which factors seem most relevant to your symptoms or participation right now?
options: A new or changing symptom I want assessed

fields.label: What pattern have you noticed?
fields.placeholder: For example: what tends to help, what tends to make participation harder, and what remains uncertain?

fields.label: One meaningful activity I want to support:
fields.placeholder: Choose something that matters to you

fields.label: One manageable action I will try:
How I will adjust if symptoms increase:
fields.placeholder: Use your flare plan, modify the dose, seek advice, or choose another appropriate response

fields.label: What would I like to discuss with my clinician?
fields.placeholder: Questions, concerns, barriers, or changes in symptoms

successMessage: Your plan has been saved. Small experiments and honest review can help you and your clinician decide what comes next.
